correctness.rationale: The three anticanonical cubics separate tangent directions at the seven Fano base points, giving nef and big -K (degree 2). Adjunction, degree/multiplicity Cauchy constraints and Fano incidence rule out additional irreducible -1 and -2 curves: exactly seven exceptional -1 curves and seven strict transforms of F2 lines -2. Their intersections are the Heawood bipartite point-line graph. An induced vertex of degree >=2 creates a singular three-curve principal block; degree<=1 decomposes into singleton and negative-definite 2x2 blocks. Independent direct enumeration of all 2^14=16384 point-line vertex subsets gives (1,14,91,322,651,728,392,58), total 2257, agreeing with the source exact rational criterion. It is an exhaustive finite consequence of the proved geometry, not a claim that numerical tests alone prove the curve inventory.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Bauer-Funke-Neumann 33645-chamber degree-two count assumes seven points in general position; the Fano blowup has seven -2 lines and only seven -1 exceptional curves, so those numbers and a general-configuration formula cannot dominate.
